_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.156 (Erekish (Precursors) profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Ancient, enigmatic beings with limited precognitive abilities. Individual Erekish can sense danger moments before it arrives.

traits.name: Premonition
traits.description: Precursor individuals and Sergeants receive a 6+ Saving Throw against all weapons fire and Area/Stream weapon Hits.

rules_text.Premonition: Precursor individuals and Sergeants receive a 6+ Saving Throw against all weapons fire and Area/Stream weapon Hits.
